contract_that_defines_the_work.name: ReuseDecisionPayload
contract_that_defines_the_work.meaning: the frozen package already specifies the reuse-decision record - four decision kinds, the chosen source with its revision, a licence reference, patch scope, rejected alternatives, the remaining gap and evidence artifacts - and nothing in internal/ or apps/ implements or consumes it. So this card is filling a declared hole, not inventing an architecture.

stage_vocabulary_already_present.record_type: BootstrapStage at internal/domain/project_workspace.go:570, persisted under KindBootstrapStage, statuses COMPLETED|PARTIAL|FAILED|NOT_STARTED
stage_vocabulary_already_present.explicit_handoff: internal/domain/project_bootstrap.go:12-14 states RESEARCH, REUSE_DECISION and IMPLEMENTATION are recorded NOT_STARTED because W08 owns them

registry_state.note: the card's verification key is absent, so dispatch would answer NOT_IMPLEMENTED rc 3 with zero assertions - never a pass. Binding it is a separate, guarded step with the full-selector regression the 旧例 requires.

first_slice_plan: 1. seal the reuse decision as a domain object conforming to ReuseDecisionPayload, refusing any field the schema forbids (additionalProperties false) and binding adoption_decision_ref to a real Artifact VersionRef
2. project the four stages from actual state for BOTH entry points, so init and Desktop read one projection, and keep NOT_STARTED distinguishable from PARTIAL and from nothing-to-do
3. FIXTURE-mode Jev recommendation protocol plus its refusal paths, since W08 must not depend on W11 or W14
4. negatives: clone implying ADOPT, a score displayed without calling Jev, skipping the reuse gate when the network is missing, no licence reference, an unsuitable candidate
